honesty.title: What this platform is, and is not
honesty.body: Egypt One is a coordination and technology layer. It does not replace government systems, issue licences or approvals, hold funds, or assert official status for any record. Authority, approvals and sovereign data stay with the competent authorities; the platform connects to them through approved, auditable integrations.
trust.securePayments.title: Secure by Design
trust.securePayments.body: Payments are handled by a licensed PSP — Egypt One never holds funds directly.
trust.verifiedProvider.title: Verified Provider Framework

trust.sourceLabels.title: Source Labels Everywhere
trust.sourceLabels.body: Each record shows whether it is live, verified, partner or demo data.
trust.privacy.title: Privacy by Design
